full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white architectural photograph presents a tall, irregular industrial building isolated against a nearly white sky. The structure fills the left and central frame, rising through stacked floors of brick, plaster, metal platforms, and narrow projecting rooms. Near the top, steep gables and chimneys interrupt the roofline, while a small round turret-like volume extends from the right side. Tall multi-pane windows and several arched openings give the façade a surprisingly domestic upper layer, but the lower stories reveal exposed beams, pipes, tanks, ladders, and cross-braced supports. A broad metal walkway runs horizontally across the middle, with railings and a stairway climbing diagonally at the right. In the lower part, thin columns and dark openings make the building look partly open and skeletal. A narrow strip of plain ground sits under the foundation, and no neighboring structures or people appear in the chosen view. The camera looks straight toward the façade from a modest distance, preserving its verticals and allowing each attached section to be read separately. Diffuse overcast light gives the pale wall surfaces a soft gray tone, while window interiors and machinery cavities remain much darker. Fine photographic grain and crisp line detail distinguish bricks, rivets, cables, and weathered plaster without creating harsh shadows. The plain sky gives the crowded structure clear negative space at both sides. The overall composition is frontal and analytical, turning an eccentric industrial silhouette into a dense study of repeated openings, exposed connections, and aging material.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白建筑摄影把一栋高耸而不规则的工业建筑单独置于近乎白色的天空前。建筑填满左侧与中央，由砖、灰泥、金属平台和窄小外凸房间叠成多层。上方尖山墙与烟囱打断屋顶线，右侧还有一个小圆塔般体量伸出。高大多格窗和几处拱形开口让立面上层意外地带有住宅感，但下层露出梁、管道、罐体、梯子和交叉支撑。宽金属步道横贯中部，带栏杆，右侧楼梯斜向上爬。下方细柱与暗开口让建筑部分敞开、近乎骨架。基础下只有一条朴素地面，所选画面没有邻楼或人物。相机从适中距离正对立面，保持竖线稳定，也让每个附着部分可分别读清。漫射阴天光把浅墙面变成柔灰，窗内与机械凹处则深得多。细微摄影颗粒和清楚线条区分砖、铆钉、线缆和风化灰泥，却不产生硬影。朴素天空让拥挤建筑两侧都拥有明确留白。整体构图正面且分析式，把奇特工业剪影变成重复开口、外露连接和老化材料的密集研究。
style_prompt_en: The image uses frontal monochrome architectural photography with a neutral pale ground and exceptionally fine structural detail. Near-white walls, middle-gray weathering, and black recesses separate projecting layers without dramatic light. Repeated openings form a loose grid, interrupted by diagonal stairs, thin railings, and round attached volumes. The camera holds vertical lines steady, giving even elaborate assemblies a measured documentary order. Fine grain, chipped plaster, exposed metal, and dark cavities provide tactile variation within the limited tonal range. Soft overcast illumination suppresses cast shadow while preserving depth through overlap and internal contrast. The overall effect is precise, austere, and quietly strange.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用正面黑白建筑摄影，以中性浅底和极细的结构细节为特征。近白墙面、中灰风化处与黑凹口分开突出的层次，而不依赖戏剧性光线。重复开口形成松散网格，被斜楼梯、细栏杆和圆形附着体打断。相机稳住竖向线条，使复杂拼装仍有审慎的纪实秩序。细颗粒、崩裂灰泥、外露金属与暗凹处在有限影调中提供触感变化。柔和阴天光压低投影，却通过重叠和内部反差保留纵深。整体效果精确、冷峻且安静奇异。
theme_en: A tall, layered industrial building isolated against a pale sky
theme_zh: 高耸层叠的工业建筑独立立于浅色天空前
name: Hilla Becher
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
